general.format: Each output is a UTF-8 JSON file in the reader's output directory, plus reader_notes.md. Every interpretive field cites locators: {doc_id, pdf_page, section_or_table}. doc_id values come from publication_packet.json (P1 = main article). Missing values are null with a reason; never fill from memory.
general.id_rules: claim_id C01..; target_id T001..; axis_id AX01..; level_id AX01.L0 (origin) / AX01.L1...; step_id S01..; variable_id V001..

claims.estimand: precise statistical quantity (e.g. standardized mean difference between named cohorts on named scale, with sign convention)
claims.population: who, which years, which questionnaire form(s)

targets.quantity: what number this is (e.g. mean, SD, d, N, percentage, t, p)

manifest.json.rule: No article identity, author names, title, journal, published numbers, published Ns, or result directions may appear in this file. Describe operations on the source data only.

data_sources.source_key: e.g. year_form key as named in the source description

variables.coding: recode rules, reverse coding, valid range

estimators.quantity: exact formula, e.g. Cohen's d with pooled SD definition and sign convention

manifest.json.outputs_required: list of quantities the implementation must output per construct/item and comparison

published_N_branch.json.rule: Published Ns per analysis cell, kept out of manifest.json; evaluated by code only.

spec_space.json.origin: closest-described specification: list of level ids, one per axis (L0)

axes.compatible_with: constraints on crossing with other axes

spec_space.json.notes: Alternatives need an article or methodological-literature basis. Explicitly reported items/controls cannot be changed within the equivalent set. Distinct reported outcomes are not interchangeable specifications.

wider_space.note: off unless explicitly included before execution

findings.check: e.g. d recomputed from printed means/SDs, p vs stars, N vs df

files.reader_notes.md: Free text: contradictions, missing appendices, redaction gaps, questions for the coordinator about missing inputs, limitations.
